verdict.rationale: Hightouch publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 spec covering 36 paths, and its docs render a REST reference from that spec with Redoc, giving browsable request and response schemas per endpoint. The API guide also shows an example request URL and bearer-token auth. However, the reference is static: no live try-it runner or runnable examples are documented. Missing for 10: interactive try-it/runnable request console, runnable code samples, independent hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
